milestones.name: False Knight Encountered
milestones.note: Player engages the False Knight boss in the Forgotten Crossroads. Segment covers all attack patterns across both phases.

zones.name: Forgotten Crossroads
zones.fingerprintHint: Dark cavern with large shield-shaped stone carvings on walls, dense mushroom/coral floor growth, deep blue-purple ambient lighting
zones.note: The arena where False Knight is fought; features a flat, wide platform with organic debris on the floor.

bosses.name: False Knight
bosses.note: Two-phase boss. Attacks include: arch jump, mace slam with shockwave, spam mace attack, and jumping mace attack. After collapsing in phase 1, attack the head. In phase 2 he rises and becomes more aggressive. Always jumps in place before the jumping mace attack.

objectives.name: Defeat False Knight
objectives.hopDescription: Attack the boss on spawn for free hits, dodge arch jump by moving aside or running under, jump over shockwave after mace slam, attack the head when he collapses, survive phase 2 mace spam, and avoid the jumping mace attack.
objectives.note: Boss has two phases; phase 2 begins after attacking the collapsed head enough times.
